summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Harbor Mid Cap Value ETF (EPMV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is actively managed, investing in 40-70 undervalued mid-cap companies in the US, selected using fundamental research. The fund seeks total return. EPMV was launched on May 1, 2025 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: EPMV is an equity ETF with a total of 61 individual holdings. The top holdings are Flex Ltd. stock at 3.68%, Cummins at 2.84%, IQVIA Holdings at 2.81%, Avnet at 2.64%, and ON Semiconductor at 2.57%.
